name: LightShow Web Stream — Self-Hosted Audio
author: LightShow Web Stream contributors
description: Free, self-hosted music streaming synchronized approximately to FPP playback; optional developer contributions.

privacy.summary: Streams FPP show audio to your HTTPS server. The optional listener support link opens Stripe. Installs a background FPP synchronization service.

sends.to: the backend HTTPS server you configure
sends.what: music files, current song, timing and device ID
sends.why: to let visitors hear the show on their phones

sends.what: visitor browser IP address and payment page request
sends.why: to open an optional developer contribution page

sends.what: visitor browser IP address and payment page request
sends.why: to support an optional configured Stripe payment URL

systemChanges.what: Installs and enables systemd service fpp-audio-preprocessed for FPP playback synchronization

privacy.other: Optional contributions support the software developer, not the show owner. Payment links open on Stripe; no payment is needed to listen. Stream only music you are licensed to use.
